# The Odesa School

> A small, privately held collection of original Odesa School paintings, 1930s–1980s: luminous color, free brushwork, the light and sea of Odesa. Prices are listed in US dollars on each painting page.

The Odesa School brought together painters working between the 1930s and 1980s who shaped a distinct southern voice within the art of that period — luminous color, free brushwork, and a deep attachment to the city's light and sea. This gallery presents a small, curated selection of original works from that period, each available for private acquisition.

All pages exist in English (https://theodesaschool.com/) and Ukrainian (https://theodesaschool.com/ua/): the Ukrainian version of any page is the same address with /ua/ after the domain.

## Main pages

- [Catalog](https://theodesaschool.com/catalog.html): Browse 91 original paintings of the Odesa School, 1930s–1980s. Every work is documented, with provenance. Prices in US dollars.
- [Artists](https://theodesaschool.com/artists.html): 14 Odesa School painters, 1930s–1980s: biographies and their works in the collection.
- [How to Buy](https://theodesaschool.com/how-to-buy.html): How to buy a painting from The Odesa School: six steps from enquiry to delivery, with payment and shipping options.
- [About the Collection](https://theodesaschool.com/about.html): The Odesa School: a privately held collection of Odesa painting from the 1930s–1980s, selected, researched and documented by its owner.
- [Contact](https://theodesaschool.com/contact.html): Contact The Odesa School: email, phone and Instagram. We reply within 2 hours.

He died on 17 July 2007 in Carrara, Italy, and is buried in Darien, Connecticut.
- [Oleksandr Atsmanchuk](https://theodesaschool.com/artist/atsmanchuk.html) (1923–1974), 3 works in the collection: Oleksandr Atsmanchuk (1923–1974) was an Odesa painter of portraits, landscapes and thematic pictures, and a teacher. He was born in Odesa on 8 September 1923 and died there on 7 October 1974.

- [Yuriy Pliss](https://theodesaschool.com/artist/pliss.html) (1954–2026), 5 works in the collection: Yuriy Pliss (1954–2026) was an Odesa avant-garde painter, graphic artist, photographer and puppet-theatre designer. He was born in Odesa in 1954, lived there all his life and died there in October 2026.
